brief.goal: Close interrupted confirmed event-config execution deterministically and recover through the existing fresh-readonly Job path.

allowed_writes: Solution Design, Task and Context Manifest
existing event-config timeout and partial-readback logic
existing confirmed-resource terminalization and presentation logic
current Case redacted database terminalization after authoritative readonly readback
forbidden_actions: all real platform writes, retries, confirmations and action grants
OAuth refresh, project/resource create, budget or bid mutation
new API, Schema, View, Gate, Plan/action type or worker
persisting sensitive or raw platform data
validation_plan: confirmed-resource failure, duplicate confirmation and fresh recovery smoke
workflow, API, interaction, security and runtime consistency checks
restart workbench and readonly-check the current Case
stop_conditions: any real platform write or automatic retry would be required
the current platform baseline cannot be established by authoritative readonly readback
the change requires a new database, Gate, Plan or public API contract
